entries.2a78543d0852fe5f: An AI-OCR service that makes handwriting recognition AI based on deep learning usable by anyone in daily work, and which the securities report names as its main product. "Intelligent OCR," which digitizes and sorts forms, and "Elastic Sorter," which sorts multiple types of forms scanned in random order into the same types, can be contracted in combination. Revenue consists of monthly usage-based fees based on the number of reads and monthly fixed fees for optional features (recurring model), and initial fees and others (selling model); initial fees are apportioned over the service provision period and recorded as revenue. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the number of usage licenses that the company and its sales partners provided to their respective customers was 3,203 (3,057 in the same period of the previous year). In May 2025, it began providing an AI agent as a standard feature to all users. No figure for this business alone is given.
entries.2d702d9e2706d807: Edge computing hardware, developed and manufactured in-house, that lets users perform AI processing on site without accessing the cloud.
entries.3831907f02b0a81c: An artificial intelligence company that provides the AI-OCR "DX Suite" on a monthly basis and is expanding into the AI agent platform "Leapnet" and others.
entries.4e7251620d05626f: The company's only segment, centered on the AI-OCR service "DX Suite" and also providing the edge computing hardware "AI inside Cube" and the AI integration platform "Leapnet." The securities report describes the business service by service, and states that the services consist of a recurring model, in which revenue is recorded continuously, and a selling model, in which revenue arises per transaction. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥4,747,946 thousand (107.9% of the previous year) and operating profit was ¥310,976 thousand (80.8%). Of revenue, the recurring model was 107.1% of the previous year and the selling model was 123.4%. Sales are made through direct sales to users and through sales via agents (partners), and the report states that the share of contracts from partner sales is higher than that from direct sales. The main counterparty was NTT DATA Corporation, at 11.9% of revenue.
entries.6d508691af6613b5: Edge computing hardware, developed and manufactured in-house, that lets users perform AI processing on site without accessing the cloud. It is a product that meets the demand of government agencies, local governments and others that wish to use it in an on-premises environment. Users install "DX Suite" and can use it simply by plugging in the power supply and a LAN cable for data transmission. It is provided under a monthly fixed-fee recurring model. In April 2025, the product lineup was renewed to 5 products. No figure for this business alone is given.
entries.70a733bc22206390: Companies of any type of business, including system development, banking, securities, insurance, retail, energy, logistics, pharmaceuticals, real estate, manufacturing and printing (cited by the securities report as adopters of DX Suite)
entries.7656df9ee91d0fcf: An AI platform premised on LLMs (large language models), integrating the technologies and services provided so far, such as "AnyData" and "Heylix."

entries.be88b9ccd69aee13: An AI platform premised on LLMs (large language models), integrating the technologies and services provided so far, such as "AnyData" and "Heylix." Companies can create and operate AI agents using their own business knowledge and various data. It can take in data such as PDFs and images for search and generation processing, and AI agents can be created with natural-language instructions or embedded into existing systems through an API. It can also be used to offer the AI created to outside parties and create new revenue opportunities. An early access (EA) version began to be offered in July 2025, and official provision began in May 2026. No figure for this business alone is given.
